name: Claude Managed Agents
desc: Managed agent harness and hosting on the Claude Platform
desc_zh: Claude 平台上托管智能体运行环境与基础设施的服务
solves: Teams hand-build agent loops and sandboxes; Managed Agents supplies the harness, tools and cloud runtime to deploy.
solves_zh: 团队常要自己搭智能体循环和沙箱，Managed Agents 提供运行框架和云端托管。
best_for: A support agent works in a demo but has no evals, sandbox or deployment path yet.
best_for_zh: 客服智能体在演示里能跑，但还没有评测、沙箱和上线方案。
